import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys,datetime
p=Path.cwd();h=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def write(n,s):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert r.returncode==0
b=(p/'reservation.json').read_bytes();assert h(b)=='5434323e40e8d6e0096bc53e5ace4c71f2a1559e186dbc3cf7bad738f25110a8'
raw=json.loads((p/'raw-provenance.json').read_text());res=json.loads((p/'results.json').read_text());assert set(raw)==set(res)==set(map(str,json.loads(b)['ids'])) and len(res)==20
chunks={};verified=[]
for i,v in raw.items():
 f=Path(v['chunk_path'])
 if str(f) not in chunks:
  z=f.read_bytes();assert h(z)==v['chunk_sha256'];chunks[str(f)]=z.splitlines(keepends=True)
 line=chunks[str(f)][v['line']-1];assert line==v['raw'].encode() and line.endswith(b'\n') and h(line)==v['raw_sha256']
 assert json.loads(line)==v['parsed'] and h(v['parsed']['statement'].encode())==v['statement_sha256']; assert res[i]['literal_statement']==v['parsed']['statement'] and res[i]['accepted_credit']==0
 verified.append(i)
for log in json.loads((p/'access.json').read_text()):assert h((p/'sources'/ (log['id']+'.pdf')).read_bytes())==log['sha256']
brief=(p/'BRIEF.md').read_text().replace('Two output reads were truncated','Several console outputs were truncated').replace('The immutable reservation was verified before extraction and will be rechecked at handback.','The immutable reservation was verified before extraction and rechecked at handback, with the exact original SHA preserved.')
write('BRIEF.md',brief)
receipts=[]
for f in sorted(p.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 r=json.loads(f.read_text());receipts.append({'path':f.name,'sha256':h(f.read_bytes()),'exit':r['exit'],'killed':r['killed'],'wall_s':r['wall_s'],'sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes':r['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'],'samples':r['samples'],'child_cpu_cumulative_s':r['child_cpu_cumulative_s']})
write('resource-inventory.json',json.dumps({'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'receipts_existing_before_this_job':receipts,'caps':'Supplied runner: affinity2, childCPU115s/supervisorCPU120s, AS6GiB, arena2, sampled process-groupRSS6GiB, deadline130s, outertimeout140s; resolved writer10s CPU/512MiBAS. True child exit and childrusage in receipts; Popen.communicate reaps jobs. No outstanding jobs.','limits':'sampled RSS can miss fast writers; writer receipts not separately sampled; child CPU cumulative is not aggregate enforcement; no cgroup/transient claim; native search telemetry unavailable. This job and final verification receipts are necessarily written after inventory creation and included in manifest according to exclusions.','exception':'extract20 exit1 wrong ancestor path; corrected unique job. Empty shell invocation no effect/unreceipted. Console truncation retained in outputs files; full read claims limited as described.','source_access':'6 public file GETs:4 success PDFs,2 comparator403. No retries. Three native search batches12 strings. Max concurrent GETthreads1; no background/orphan.','own_bootstrap_receipt_sha256':h((p/'bootstrap-receipt.json').read_bytes()),'verification':{'reservation_sha256':h(b),'exact20_raw_newline_bindings_verified':verified,'chunk_count':len(chunks),'all4_PDF_hashes_reverified':True},'historical':'350 completed exact allowlisted files scanned twice (700 file reads), protected names filtered before each open; title/source-family matches preserved. No current global registry clearance.'},indent=2))
exclusions=['manifest.json','inventory_manifest.receipt.json','inventory_manifest.output.txt','verify_handback.receipt.json','verify_handback.output.txt']
files={str(f.relative_to(p)):h(f.read_bytes()) for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')) if f.is_file() and str(f.relative_to(p)) not in exclusions}
write('manifest.json',json.dumps({'sha256':files,'exclusions':exclusions,'reason':'Manifest cannot hash itself or receipts/outputs generated after it. Final verification reports excluded inventory job receipt hashes explicitly. All other actual lane files, including prior receiptJSONs, are hashed. No external/protected tree traversal.'},indent=2))
print(json.dumps({'exact20':len(verified),'reservation':h(b),'chunk_count':len(chunks),'manifest_files':len(files),'receipt_count_before_this_job':len(receipts),'exit1_jobs':[r['path'] for r in receipts if r['exit']!=0]}))
